sentences.en: The giant plane screamed down in an almost vertical dive.
sentences.zh: 那架巨大的飞机几乎垂直俯冲而下。

sentences.en: Tango is the vertical expression of a horizontal desire.
sentences.zh: 探戈是横向欲望的垂直表达。

sentences.en: The graph of the cosecant function has vertical asymptotes.
sentences.zh: 余割函数图的垂直渐近线表明了其行为特征。
